The plan's canonical Arabic is خطة التأهب الصحي والطبي للفعالية (SPEC 7 glossary). The looser form drifted into four places -- the next-action panel, roles.json twice and material-change.json -- because nothing checked it. التأهب is preparedness, this instrument; الجاهزية is cardiac readiness, and the two are not interchangeable.
